Fever''' is a [[spell]] that grants a similarly-named [[buff]]. While the buff is active, [[hit]]ting enemies will inflict stacks of {{stl|Corrupted Blood}} on them that deal [[physical damage|physical]] [[damage over time]], up to a maximum of 10 stacks. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Casting Corrupting Fever costs [[life]] instead of [[mana]]. Spending enough life while the Corrupting Fever buff is active will refresh its [[duration]]; the spent life threshold is much lower than the cost of Corrupting Fever itself. * Inflicting a new stack of corrupted blood on a target will refresh the duration of all stacks currently on that target, as is common with all corruped blood mechanics. * Hits do not need to deal damage in order to inflict corrupting blood stacks. * As it does only Damage Over Time, it is not affected by modifiers to Spell Damage. * [[Proxy|Proxies]] such as Totems, Traps and Mines will not inflict corrupted blood on hit as they cannot inherit the Corrupting Fever buff from the player.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3078780/page/2#p23983899 ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical
DPS |c1_header = Deals x Base Physical Damage per second |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+%.*%d*) Base Physical Damage per second |c1_pattern_value = %s |c2_abbr = Life Spent to Refresh |c2_header = Buff Duration refreshed after spending x life |c2_pattern_extract = Buff Duration is refreshed after you spend a total of (%d+) Life |c2_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Trivia== The skill gem's description erroneously describes the debuff inflicted as "Corrupting Blood"; however, the Helmet Enchantment and gem quality correctly lists the debuff as {{stl|Corrupted Blood}}, which it shares mechanics with other sources of. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Corrupting Fever: Base Debuff Duration is now 1.5 seconds (previously 1), and now deals 411.7 base Physical Damage per second at gem level 20 (previously 335.4). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Removed "Triggering this Skill still requires paying its Cost". {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=Community_Team|date=April 9, 2021|title=How does Corrupting Fever interact with Crimson Dance ?|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/mn5rfv/how_does_corrupting_fever_interact_with_crimson/gtvo1g7|publisher=Path of Exile subreddit|accessdate=November 18, 2021}} }} {{Navbox Skills}}
